name: rockscord-monorepo
description: RocksCord - a self-hostable, real-time chat platform (Discord-style). Monorepo root.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rockscord/shared && npm run build -w @rockscord/server && npm run build -w @rockscord/web
scripts.build:apk: node apps/mobile/scripts/configure.mjs && npm run build -w @rockscord/web && cd apps/mobile && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rockscord/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rockscord/server && npm run typecheck -w @rockscord/web
